title: Babe
summary: BABE, noun [Latin pupus, a word of endearment; pupa, little girl; whence pupillus, pupilla, pupil.] An infant; a young child of either sex.

inlines.v: BABE, noun [Latin pupus, a word of endearment; pupa, little girl; whence pupillus, pupilla, pupil.] An infant; a young child of either sex.
